Feed from storage Where a line leaves or joins the sheet; sources and consumers off the drawing
Y-101 Feed strainer A Y-strainer
P-101 Feed pump A centrifugal pump
E-101 Feed preheater A shell-and-tube heat exchanger Warms the feed against the hot bottoms before it reaches the column; the heat itself is not modelled here.
C-101 Column A trayed column: distillation, absorption or stripping; shows the level in its sump The lighter part of the feed rises through the trays as vapour; the heavier part falls to the sump.
E-102 Overhead condenser An air cooler: a fin-fan over a tube bundle
D-101 Reflux drum A horizontal drum on saddles: a receiver, separator or accumulator; shows its level
P-102 Distillate pump A centrifugal pump
LV-101 Distillate valve A valve with an actuator; its opening follows the signal Opens as the drum fills, so the drum holds about half full; it shuts if its air fails.
Distillate to storage Where a line leaves or joins the sheet; sources and consumers off the drawing
LV-102 Bottoms valve A valve with an actuator; its opening follows the signal
V-101 Bottoms isolation An isolating valve; filled when shut
Bottoms to storage Where a line leaves or joins the sheet; sources and consumers off the drawing
PI-101: pressure: indicate
LT-101: level: transmit
LIC-101: level: indicate, control
LT-102: level: transmit
LIC-102: level: indicate, control
